```{r}
original_data <- read.csv("1-s2.0-S1090513816301118-mmc1.csv")
replication_data <- read.csv("Raw_Data_Complete.csv", sep = ";")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "svglite", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6)
plot_font <- "Helvetica Neue LT Std 57 Condensed"
sysfonts::font_add(
  family = plot_font,
  regular = "Helvetica Neue LT Std 57 Condensed.otf"
)
showtext::showtext_auto()
study_palette <- c(Original = "#00AFBB", Replication = "#E7B800")
publication_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = plot_font) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.key.height = unit(13, "pt"),
    legend.key.width = unit(18, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 6, 0),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 4)),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
  )
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Replication scale scoring

| Raw items | Scale | Scoring and direction |
|---|---|---|
| Q15_1–Q15_9 | Adolescent Attachment Questionnaire (AAQ) | Reverse 4–9 with `6 - x`; sum. Higher = poorer attachment (9–45). |
| Q16_1–Q16_23 | DSM-5 Level 1 Cross-Cutting Symptom Measure—Adult | Subtract 1 from each item; sum. Higher = more symptoms (0–92). |
| Q17_1–Q17_29 | Buss–Perry Aggression Questionnaire | Reverse 7 and 18 with `6 - x`; sum. Higher = more aggression (29–145). |
| Q18_1–Q18_20 | Mini-K | Subtract 3 from each item; sum. Higher = slower life-history strategy (−40–40). |
| Q19_1–Q19_22 | High-K Strategy Scale (HKSS) | Sum without reversing. Higher = higher-K/slower strategy (22–110). |
| Seventeen self-harm behaviours and their frequency follow-ups | Deliberate Self-Harm Inventory (DSHI) | Sum valid reported occurrence counts; see the missing-data rules below. |


```{r}
replication_included <- replication_data %>%
  filter(ResponseId != "R_e4KcPgvKpQpamWd")

# Separate scored item data so that the raw Q variables remain unchanged.
replication_items <- replication_included %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 4:9)), ~ 6 - .x),
    across(all_of(paste0("Q16_", 1:23)), ~ .x - 1),
    across(all_of(paste0("Q17_", c(7, 18))), ~ 6 - .x),
    across(all_of(paste0("Q18_", 1:20)), ~ .x - 3)
  )

# A missing item produces a missing total; no prorating or partial sums.
replication_scales <- replication_items %>%
  transmute(
    ResponseId,
    Age = 2020 - Q2,
    AAQ_Angry = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 1:3)))),
    AAQ_Avail = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 4:6)))),
    AAQ_Goal = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 7:9)))),
    Attach_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 1:9)))),
    AQ_Physical = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q17_", 1:9)))),
    AQ_Verbal = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q17_", 10:14)))),
    AQ_Anger = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q17_", 15:21)))),
    AQ_Hostility = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q17_", 22:29)))),
    # Preserve the original dataset's spelling for comparisons.
    Aggresion_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q17_", 1:29)))),
    DSM5_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q16_", 1:23)))),
    MiniK_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q18_", 1:20)))),
    HKSS_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("Q19_", 1:22))))
  )
```


## Self-harm frequencies

```{r}
self_harm_key <- tribble(
  ~behaviour,                  ~screen_item, ~frequency_item,
  "Cutting",                   "Q20",        "Q22",
  "Burning with cigarette",    "Q29",        "Q122",
  "Burning with lighter",      "Q120",       "Q63",
  "Carving words",             "Q30",        "Q64",
  "Biting",                    "Q31",        "Q65",
  "Carving pictures",          "Q32",        "Q66",
  "Severe scratching",         "Q33",        "Q67",
  "Rubbing sandpaper",         "Q34",        "Q68",
  "Dripping acid",             "Q35",        "Q69",
  "Using cleaning chemicals",  "Q36",        "Q70",
  "Sticking sharp objects",    "Q40",        "Q71",
  "Rubbing glass",             "Q37",        "Q72",
  "Breaking bones",            "Q38",        "Q73",
  "Banging head",              "Q39",        "Q74",
  "Punching self",             "Q126",       "Q128",
  "Preventing wound healing",  "Q41",        "Q75",
  "Other self-harm",           "Q42",        "Q76"
)

self_harm_items <- pmap_dfr(
  self_harm_key,
  function(behaviour, screen_item, frequency_item) {
    tibble(
      ResponseId = replication_included$ResponseId,
      behaviour = behaviour,
      screen_item = screen_item,
      frequency_item = frequency_item,
      endorsed_raw = replication_included[[.env$screen_item]],
      frequency_raw = as.character(replication_included[[.env$frequency_item]])
    )
  }
) %>%
  mutate(
    frequency_text = trimws(frequency_raw),
    blank = is.na(frequency_text) | frequency_text == "",
    # Strict conversion: do not extract numbers from ambiguous free text.
    frequency_numeric = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(frequency_text)),
    issue = case_when(
      is.na(endorsed_raw) | !(endorsed_raw %in% c(1, 2)) ~
        "Missing or invalid yes/no response",
      endorsed_raw == 2 & blank ~ NA_character_,
      blank ~ "Yes, but no frequency supplied",
      !is.finite(frequency_numeric) ~ "Non-numeric or non-finite frequency",
      frequency_numeric < 0 ~ "Negative frequency",
      frequency_numeric != floor(frequency_numeric) ~ "Fractional count",
      endorsed_raw == 1 & frequency_numeric == 0 ~ "Yes, but zero frequency",
      endorsed_raw == 2 & frequency_numeric > 0 ~ "No, but positive frequency",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    frequency_scored = case_when(
      !is.na(issue) ~ NA_real_,
      endorsed_raw == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ frequency_numeric
    ),
    endorsed = case_when(
      endorsed_raw == 1 ~ 1L,
      endorsed_raw == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

self_harm_issues <- self_harm_items %>%
  filter(!is.na(issue)) %>%
  select(ResponseId, behaviour, screen_item, frequency_item,
         endorsed_raw, frequency_raw, issue)

self_harm_scores <- self_harm_items %>%
  group_by(ResponseId) %>%
  summarise(
    SH_Total = sum(frequency_scored),
    # Additional descriptive count, distinct from the paper's frequency total.
    SH_Behaviour_Count = sum(endorsed),
    SH_Frequency_Issues = sum(!is.na(issue)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

replication_scored <- replication_included %>%
  left_join(replication_scales, by = "ResponseId") %>%
  left_join(self_harm_scores, by = "ResponseId") %>%
  mutate(
    Psychopathology_Index = DSM5_Total,
    Mini_K_Total_Score = MiniK_Total
  )

self_harm_issues
```


# Reproductions

Original paper:

```{r}
original_data %>%
    select(Age, MiniK_Total, DSM5_Total) %>%
    pcor(., method = "pearson")
```

Replication:

```{r}
replication_scored %>%
  select(Age, MiniK_Total, DSM5_Total) %>%
  pcor(., method = "pearson")
```


```{r}
focal_scores <- bind_rows(
  Original = original_data %>%
    transmute(MiniK_Total, DSM5_Total = DSM5_Total - 23),
  Replication = replication_scored %>%
    select(MiniK_Total, DSM5_Total),
  .id = "Study"
)

focal_correlations <- focal_scores %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(complete.cases(MiniK_Total, DSM5_Total)),
    r = cor(MiniK_Total, DSM5_Total, use = "complete.obs")
  )

focal_correlations

focal_plot <- ggscatterhist(
  focal_scores,
  x = "MiniK_Total", y = "DSM5_Total",
  color = "Study", size = 1.1, alpha = 0.55,
  palette = unname(study_palette),
  margin.plot = "density",
  margin.params = list(fill = "Study", color = "black", size = 0.2),
  add = "reg.line", add.params = list(linewidth = 0.45),
  conf.int = TRUE, cor.coef = FALSE,
  title = "Mini-K and DSM-5",
  xlab = "Mini-K total score\n ", ylab = "DSM-5 total (0-92)",
  ggtheme = publication_theme, font.family = plot_font,
  print = FALSE
)
study_legend <- get_legend(focal_plot$sp)
focal_plot$sp <- focal_plot$sp +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(8, 2, 2, 2))
focal_figure <- print(focal_plot)

```


# Data quality checks

## Reverse-coded attachment (AAQ) items

```{r}
aaq_item_means <- bind_rows(
  Original = original_data %>%
    transmute(
      reverse_keyed_mean = 6 - rowMeans(pick(all_of(sprintf("AAQ_%02d", 4:9)))),
      remaining_mean = rowMeans(pick(all_of(sprintf("AAQ_%02d", 1:3))))
    ),
  Replication = replication_included %>%
    transmute(
      reverse_keyed_mean = rowMeans(pick(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 4:9)))),
      remaining_mean = rowMeans(pick(all_of(paste0("Q15_", 1:3))))
    ),
  .id = "Study"
)

aaq_correlations <- aaq_item_means %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(complete.cases(reverse_keyed_mean, remaining_mean)),
    r = cor(reverse_keyed_mean, remaining_mean, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(reverse_keyed_mean, remaining_mean, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )

aaq_correlations

aaq_plot <- ggscatterhist(
  aaq_item_means,
  x = "reverse_keyed_mean", y = "remaining_mean",
  color = "Study", size = 1.1, alpha = 0.55,
  palette = unname(study_palette),
  margin.plot = "density",
  margin.params = list(fill = "Study", color = "black", size = 0.2),
  add = "reg.line", add.params = list(linewidth = 0.45),
  conf.int = TRUE, cor.coef = FALSE,
  title = "AAQ",
  xlab = "Reverse-keyed mean\n(unreversed)",
  ylab = "Remaining-item mean",
  ggtheme = publication_theme, font.family = plot_font,
  print = FALSE
)
aaq_plot$sp <- aaq_plot$sp +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(8, 2, 2, 2))
aaq_figure <- print(aaq_plot)


```

## Reverse coded BPA items

```{r}
bpa_item_means <- bind_rows(
  Original = original_data %>%
    transmute(
      reverse_keyed_mean = 6 - rowMeans(pick(all_of(sprintf("BPAS_%02d", c(7, 18))))),
      remaining_mean = rowMeans(pick(all_of(sprintf("BPAS_%02d", setdiff(1:29, c(7, 18))))))
    ),
  Replication = replication_included %>%
    transmute(
      reverse_keyed_mean = rowMeans(pick(all_of(paste0("Q17_", c(7, 18))))),
      remaining_mean = rowMeans(pick(all_of(paste0("Q17_", setdiff(1:29, c(7, 18))))))
    ),
  .id = "Study"
)

bpa_correlations <- bpa_item_means %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(complete.cases(reverse_keyed_mean, remaining_mean)),
    r = cor(reverse_keyed_mean, remaining_mean, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(reverse_keyed_mean, remaining_mean, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )

bpa_correlations

bpa_plot <- ggscatterhist(
  bpa_item_means,
  x = "reverse_keyed_mean", y = "remaining_mean",
  color = "Study", size = 1.1, alpha = 0.55,
  palette = unname(study_palette),
  margin.plot = "density",
  margin.params = list(fill = "Study", color = "black", size = 0.2),
  add = "reg.line", add.params = list(linewidth = 0.45),
  conf.int = TRUE, cor.coef = FALSE,
  title = "BPAS",
  xlab = "Reverse-keyed mean\n(unreversed)",
  ylab = "Remaining-item mean",
  ggtheme = publication_theme, font.family = plot_font,
  print = FALSE
)
bpa_plot$sp <- bpa_plot$sp +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(8, 2, 2, 2))
bpa_figure <- print(bpa_plot)


```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.1
#| fig-cap: "Panel A shows unadjusted Mini-K and DSM-5 total scores and linear fits; the focal test reported above is a partial correlation controlling for age. All panels use the same replication sample (n = 68)."
publication_figure <- ggarrange(
  focal_figure, aaq_figure, bpa_figure,
  ncol = 3, nrow = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top", legend.grob = study_legend,
  labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
  font.label = list(size = 15, face = "plain", family = plot_font),
  label.x = 0.01, label.y = 0.99, hjust = 0, vjust = 1
)
publication_figure

ggsave("figures/hurst_three_panel.svg", publication_figure,
       device = svglite::svglite, width = 7, height = 3.1, bg = "white")
```
